title: The film New Orleans with Louis Armstrong, 1947
summary: Callender played bass with Armstrong, Billie Holiday, Bigard and Kid Ory in the film, and calls it a high point.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: And jumping ahead to 1947 (which I seem to be good at jumping around) was another film that I enjoyed doing. This was with Louis Armstrong, also Billie Holiday, and Barney Bigard, Kid Ory, the guitar player Bud Scott,

Zutty Singleton, Charlie Beal (I was still the kid, remember), and me -- I played bass. It was a film called New Orleans. And I think we recorded most of the music from the film on RCA, because this was Pops' chance to introduce each member of the band. That was one of the high points of my life, too.
